title: NET-ex Evaluation of MRI of the liver in the diagnostic accuracy of extrahepatic metastases
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the diagnostic value of MRI of the liver compared with somatostatin receptor PET/CT for staging/re-staging of patient with metastatic NETs.
conditions: Secondary malignant neoplasm of large intestine and rectum
Secondary malignant neoplasm of other and unspecified respiratory organs

interventions.name:
Cohort study: retrospective, non-randomized, monocentric, single-arm study. 
This study is a retrospective cohort analysis. We evaluate data from patients with neuroendocrine tumors who underwent liver MRI with liver-specific contrast agent and 68Ga-DOTATATE (-TOC, NOC) PET/CT at a maximum interval

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who have MRI of the liver with liver-specific contrast agent including DWI on a 1.5T scanner and prompt (within 3 months) adjacent somatostatin receptor PET/CT by the Department and Polyclinic of Radiology and the Department of Nuclear Medicine of the University Hospital of Munich.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients who have shown artifacts on imaging.
